description: ⛓️ Reference Waves Blockchain Node (client) implementation on Scala
readme_summary: > Waves is an open source blockchain protocol. You can use it to build your own decentralized applications. Waves provides full blockchain ecosystem including smart contracts language called RIDE. Waves node is a host connected to the blockchain network with the following functions: - Processing and validation of transactions - Generation and storage of blocks - Network communication with other nodes - REST API - Extensions management A quick introduction of the minimal setup you need to get a running node. *Prerequisites:* - configuration file for a needed network from here - `waves-all*.jar` file from releases > More details on how to install a node for different platforms you can find in the documentation.
